note: The statewide ORKA parcel layer (KS_Parcels_ORKA_EB, 23,861 features) has only CO_ABBR values CN, RA, SH, TH; a query over the full Wallace bbox and the sample point returns zero Wallace parcels (only Sherman SH parcels at the bbox edge). ORKA lists Wallace parcels only via a per-county request process. The county site wallacecounty.net returns 403. Remaining Wallace parcel sources (Regrid, Dynamo Spatial, Acres, Rockford Map) are paid/commercial, not public services.
